Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: In the second step (the first Planner response after the initial WebSurfer search), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the president was Warren G. Harding. The WebSurfer had only confirmed that Woodrow Wilson was the president associated with the Versailles Treaty defeat. The Planner hallucinated a connection to Harding and his child, Elizabeth Ann Blaesing, without any evidence from the search results, leading to a completely wrong direction for the rest of the conversation.
